summary: Ennis, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01, reporting quarterly financial results for the three months ended May 31, 2026, and announcing its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders to be held on July 16, 2026. The press release shows revenues of $98.6M, EPS of $0.39, and a declared quarterly dividend. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings and meeting notice with no transaction terms, advisors, or structural mechanics.
